newsitem.title: USA: Clinton, Hashimoto to hold informal meeting.
newsitem.headline: Clinton, Hashimoto to hold informal meeting.

text.p: President Bill Clinton invited Japanese Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto to the White House late on Thursday night for an informal conversation over coffee ahead of their official talks on Friday.

White House spokeswoman Mary Ellen Glynn said Hashimoto would "come over for a private, informal chat." He arrived from Tokyo on Thursday evening and was staying at the Blair House guest residence across the street from the White House.
Glynn said Clinton would meet Hashimoto after a Senate vote on a chemical weapons treaty.
"They want to meet outside the strict, formal setting of a summit meeting," she said. "That's President Clinton's style. It's the way he likes to do business."

The two leaders are to hold official talks on Friday. Earlier this month, Clinton had invited visiting Canadian Prime Minister Jean Chretien to the White House for a chat on the night before their formal talks.
